arguments.text: `tzres.name_from_string` raises `ValueError("Malformed timezone string.")`. For a string starting with '@' it splits on `',-'` and does `int(name_splt[1])` inside a bare `except:` that re-raises as `ValueError` (so an unparseable/missing offset, e.g. `'@tzres.dll,foo'`, gives that ValueError rather than IndexError/TypeError).
It returns the `default` argument (i.e. `None` when not supplied): the method is just `return self.zones.get(name, default)`.
